evidence_body: BOTIA's evidence, sources and regulatory documentation are public and can be consulted on our website.
headline: Discover what your ingredients say
subheadline: Photograph the real ingredient list of a product. BOTIA reads it, analyses its ingredients and shows you the information and evidence available.
step1_body: Take a photo of the real ingredient list on the package.
step2_body: We analyse the ingredients and organise the available evidence.
step3_body: Open the evidence and consult the sources.
android_body: BOTIA is available on Google Play.
try_body: You can also analyse a label here using the same ingredient-analysis engine.
dz_main: Drop a photo here, paste it, or tap to choose one
dz_sub: A clear photo of the ingredient list. JPG or PNG.
res_none: BOTIA found nothing it flags in this list.
msg_not_image: That file is not an image.
msg_too_big: That image is too large. Try one under 6 MB.
msg_unreadable: No ingredients found. Try a clearer photo.
msg_error: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
funding: BOTIA is financed by the subscriptions of the people who use it. Brands do not pay to appear or to be shown.
principle1: BOTIA reads what the label declares.
principle2: It does not diagnose, certify or advise.
principle3: It is not medical, nutritional or religious guidance.
